stemMd: A workshop reduced the time spent on each repair but completed fewer repairs per week. Which explanation best reconciles this?

options.label: C
options.textMd: It received fewer repair jobs, leaving staff idle for part of the week.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The staff used the same uniforms.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The workshop displayed its opening hours.

explanationMd: Productivity per job is not identical to weekly output. Faster repair can coexist with fewer completions if there are fewer jobs available. The explanation changes utilization rather than contradicting improved speed.

distractorRationale.a: Invoicing is not stated to have changed.
distractorRationale.e: A sign does not establish arrivals or completed jobs.
distractorRationale.d: Uniform consistency is irrelevant to output.
distractorRationale.b: New tools might explain speed but not the lower job total without a demand change.
